ready.feedback_good: Prepared with a compact ready position.
ready.feedback_bad: Late preparation — get the non-dominant hand on the throat earlier.
ready.ideal: Two hands set, shoulders square to the net.

unit_turn.feedback_good: Early shoulder turn loading the backhand side.
unit_turn.feedback_bad: Unit turn is late — turn as the ball leaves the opponent's racquet.
unit_turn.ideal: Shoulders turn so the back faces the net.

takeback.feedback_good: Compact takeback keeping both hands on the racquet.
takeback.feedback_bad: Takeback is loopy — keep it compact and connected.
takeback.ideal: Racquet taken back with both hands, tip up.

racquet_drop.feedback_bad: Hitting too flat from a high slot — drop the head before swinging.
racquet_drop.ideal: Racquet head below the ball before the forward swing.

acceleration.feedback_bad: Arms are disconnecting from the torso — rotate the core into the shot.

contact.feedback_good: Solid contact height out in front.
contact.feedback_bad: Contact is cramped — step in and meet the ball earlier.
contact.ideal: Contact in front of the front hip.

extension.feedback_bad: Pulling off the ball — drive the hands toward the target.
extension.ideal: Both arms extend toward the target.

finish.feedback_good: High finish over the hitting shoulder.
finish.feedback_bad: Finish is abbreviated — let the hands wrap up high.
finish.ideal: Hands finish over the hitting-side shoulder.
